note: NGPC recreation area on 118-acre Olive Creek Lake, between Kramer and Hallam, SW of Lincoln. A handful of basic gravel pull-in sites with tables off the west side of the entrance road, north of the boat-ramp lot; no electric. Water and vault toilets, boat ramp and fishing jetties. --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (2025 grid row, Parks_Locations 'Active'/'Open'), basic only, first-come. Fees 10/15 confirmed; fee note's online reservation fee removed (no reservations). Facilities now sourced. SITES 28 -> null (NGPC maps only sites 2-6). WATERFRONT DOWN lakefront -> not waterfront: the 'pads at the end of finger jetties' are rock fishing jetties; the inventory's sites sit ~100-130 m from the lake behind the entrance road, lawn and a shoreline tree belt. Pin ~180 m off (optional move). Note corrected.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> not waterfront (down; contrary to the stored evidence, which read the jetties as pads). NGPC's own campsite inventory puts the campground (sites 2-6) at 40.5792-40.5796,-96.8481..-96.8484, gravel pull-ins on the WEST side of the entrance road. Between them and the 118-acre lake: the road, ~60-90 m of mown lawn/day-use with scattered trees, then a continuous shoreline tree belt; ~100-130 m to the water. The rock structures the old evidence called 'finger jetties with pull-in pads' are fishing jetties (one carries the path north from the boat-ramp lot); none is a campsite in the inventory. The tree belt screens the lake in NAIP summer imagery, so no lakeview either.

PIN (optional, under the 250 m line): stored 40.58100,-96.84800 is in the trees beside the north cove, ~180 m north of the sites. Sites centroid is 40.57940,-96.84825 (visible gravel pull-ins). Move if you want it on the loop.
PHONE missing -> 402-796-2362 (2025 grid row 'Olive Creek SRA'; NGPC Parks_Locations; it is the Pawnee SRA office). Google shows no phone. apply.py does not write phones.

SITES 28 -> null: the inventory maps sites 2-6 only (site 1 not mapped), imagery agrees with ~5-6 pull-ins; RV Life says 50. Parks_Locations calls it 'PrimitiveCampingOnly', so camping off the numbered sites may exist; no count can be sourced.

NOTE: 'near Kramer/Wilber' corrected to Kramer and Hallam (NGPC's physical address is Hallam; Wilber is a county south). The 'park entry permit required' line was dropped as general to all NGPC areas.

WEBSITE https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/olive-creek/ unread (domain blocked); Google links the same page. SAND: not applicable. FIT: gravel pull-ins look ~10-15 m long on imagery, fine for 23 ft. Google 1.0 from 1 review.
